verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a Python library/framework whose entire interface is a documented, public, programmatic API (AssistantAgent, teams, tool use, memory, serialization, etc.), installable via pip and exercised via code like `agent.run(task=...)`, with GitHub examples showing programmatic orchestration (AgentTool, MCP integration). This directly satisfies driving the product via a documented public API for AI-native/agentic use. missing for 10: no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (llms.txt and openapi.json probes 404), and no independent third-party API-usage corroboration beyond community sentiment.
